title: Local durable worker e2e is red at base: no-commits since xd3's wip snapshot
body:
TestTheDurableRunnerRunsAWholeWorkerOnTheHarness fails at 091225a4 with verdict no-commits. Since xd3, the wip checkpoint is a snapshot ON TOP of the agent's HEAD, force-pushed and invisible to the branch's own history, so a worker that never commits leaves nothing collect counts (the test's faux transcript never commits). The local host (harness/src/local/worker-host.ts) also never retires its last snapshot the way the cloud host does (retireWipSnapshot) before the supervisor's push. So a supervisor push of HEAD after a dirty round may be refused as non-fast-forward over the snapshot (pushBranch's reflog rescue cannot apply: the snapshot was never on the branch). Decide: should the local host retire the snapshot and salvage-commit uncommitted work at the end, as the cloud finish phase does, or should the test's transcript commit? It keeps CI's full go job red, which is the epic's [A5].
evidence: go test -run TestTheDurableRunnerRunsAWholeWorkerOnTheHarness -count=1 ./internal/exec/subprocess/ — internal/exec/subprocess/local_host_e2e_test.go:119 — verdict no-commits, want ready-to-merge (reproduced at base in a clean worktree); harness/src/workspace/checkpoints.ts retireWipSnapshot has no caller in harness/src/local/
